product_metadata.title: Chef'n Sleekstor Large VeggiSteam 11-Inch Silicone Steamer, Cherry
features: Large silicone vegetable steamer; great for bigger pots and bigger vegetables; ideal size for artichokes
Will not stain; top rack dishwasher safe; safe to use in microwave
Inspired, effective, agile, inventive, adaptive – by Chef'n
description: With its sleek lines and expanded surface area the Chef'n SleekStor Large VeggiSteam Silicone Steamer is a steaming revolution. Bigger vegetables need bigger pots and bigger pots need bigger steamers. This large, steamer is perfect for large pots and large vegetables – like artichokes. It has a silicone body with a nylon core; it is 650°F (340°C) heat resistant! It will not stain or retain food tastes and odors. All VeggiSteams are top rack dishwasher safe and safe to use in the microwave. Cherry color. 11-inch in diameter. Made by Chef'n. Chef'n began twenty years ago based on the principle that kitchen products could be a lot smarter, easier and more fun. Right from day one, Chef'n found an audience hungry for its brand of Tasteful Ingenuity. Today that legacy lives on with the precision refinements to acclaimed inventions, new technologies, design techniques, and entirely new products.
